title: Principle-Driven Self-Alignment of Language Models from Scratch with Minimal Human Supervision

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice question answering on ambiguous contexts to test stereotype reliance (e.g., technology proficiency by age) using a prompt from the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ).
Pronoun resolution and fill-in-the-blank tasks for occupational roles to test gender stereotypes (e.g., assuming a nurse's gender) using a prompt from the Winogender dataset.
Qualitative evaluation of model responses to sensitive and potentially harmful open-ended questions concerning race and systemic disparities using the PALMS Sensitive Questions dataset.
